title: Cozy Mystery
subtitle: An amateur detective, a small town, one body. Plays against most of the genre
note: A genre, not a show. Nobody owns the tropes. Type a series name in the app if you want a sharper card.

items.label: Scenic establishing shot
items.hint: Coastline, village green, country lane. Usually between scenes

items.label: Someone lies to the detective
items.hint: You know it is a lie. It does not have to be proven yet

items.label: Overheard conversation
items.hint: Someone hears something they were not meant to

items.label: Tea or coffee poured
items.hint: Poured, offered or carried. Drinking it is optional

items.label: A question nobody wants to answer
items.hint: The detective asks; the room goes quiet

items.label: Someone walks in unannounced
items.hint: No knock, or a knock nobody waited for

items.label: The body is found
items.hint: On screen or reported. First discovery only

items.label: A red herring suspect
items.hint: Someone is set up to look guilty and is not

items.label: Told to stay out of it
items.hint: An official tells the detective this is not their business

items.label: A will or inheritance
items.hint: Money that changes hands on a death gets mentioned

items.label: A small detail breaks a lie
items.hint: A hat, a time, a stain. Something tiny undoes a story

items.label: Weather at the wrong moment
items.hint: Rain, fog or wind arrives exactly when it is dramatic

items.label: FREE
items.hint: Free space

items.label: The aha moment
items.hint: The detective visibly realises something, usually mid-sentence

items.label: Everyone in one room
items.hint: All the suspects assembled for the explanation

items.label: Flashback reconstruction
items.hint: The crime replayed, right or wrong

items.label: A letter or paper read aloud
items.hint: Out loud, to someone else or to camera

items.label: Someone has a secret second life
items.hint: A hidden name, marriage, debt or past

items.label: The local officer is sceptical
items.hint: Police doubt the amateur, out loud

items.label: A locked door or window matters
items.hint: How someone got in or out is the question

items.label: An alibi timed to the minute
items.hint: Clocks, trains, timetables. The minutes are the point

items.label: The murderer confesses out loud
items.hint: Says it. Not just caught, told

items.label: One last attempt to escape
items.hint: A run, a car, a weapon after being named

items.label: A friend of the detective is a suspect
items.hint: Someone they know is genuinely in the frame

items.label: A second body
items.hint: A second death after the first is being investigated
